name: scattered browser tabs tumble to a save
looks: A swarm of small browser-tab cards tumbles in loose 3D over a dark field, a big dim count ("37 open tabs") behind them, then settles as a bold line reads "I saved it" with the cards arranged loosely around the words. The frame then wipes to a flat colour field on a circle from centre.
build: variant-stack-reveal, exaggerated: 10-15 DOM or three.js cards with randomised depth, rotation and drift (seeded), converging loosely toward the headline's baseline on staggered springs; exit on transitions.md's circle wipe.
sound: A soft clutter of small whooshes as the cards tumble, a settle hit on "I saved it", a wipe whoosh on the cut.
prompt: Open on a swarm of small reference cards tumbling loosely in 3D over a dark field, with a faint oversized count behind them naming the mess. Let them settle loosely around a short confident headline that names the fix. Exit on a circle wipe to a flat colour field.
